Pull a card every 60 seconds.

LCS is your local card shop for One Piece: a row of card vending machines. Every 60 seconds the next machine in the rotation drops a free card to one pirate on the leaderboard. Bigger crew value, better odds. Or skip the wait: put in your own berries and pull from any machine, from East Blue up to Egghead.

How it works

01

Pick a machine

Eight machines, one for each island. Cheap East Blue machines mostly hold rookies. Wano and Egghead hold the Emperors.

02

Drop in berries

The coin rolls in, the spiral turns, and a sealed pack falls into the tray. Rare packs start glowing before you open them.

03

Flip the card

Six rarities: C, UC, R, SR, SEC and the manga rare. One in 15 cards comes out as an alt art with a gold foil frame worth 3×.

04

Grow your crew

Every card adds to your crew value, which climbs the leaderboard and raises your odds of winning the free drop every 60 seconds.
